answer: A numbered crystal hourglass holding sand and one dyed kernel stands at a voyage terminal; its sand runs one hour. The holder turns it once at the departure bell and photographs sand level and kernel with the date. Two verifiers turn it again within 24 hours and match level, kernel, and number; an hourglass never turned at the bell or a duplicate number locks and burns the deposit. One turn is cheap; 100 fakes need 100 hourglasses and 100 trips.
